papers.title: Constant-pH Molecular Dynamics Rationalizes Photoinduced Decarboxylation in Fluorescent Proteins
papers.zh: 用恒 pH 分子动力学模拟多种荧光蛋白变体，揭示光致脱羧要求相关酸性残基处于去质子化态。

papers.title: Preparation of a high specificity imidacloprid monoclonal antibody and its application in homogeneous fluorescence immunoassay based on hydrogel beads assembling CdSe/ZnS quantum dots
papers.zh: 制备吡虫啉单克隆抗体，结合包埋 CdSe/ZnS 量子点的水凝胶微珠实现均相荧光免疫检测，ELISA 检出限 0.04 µg/L。

papers.title: Finite-Depth Interfacial Coupling in Metal/Topological Insulator van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.zh: 用 ARPES 与第一性原理研究 TiTe2/Bi2Te3 范德华异质结，发现界面杂化引起的能带可延伸至四层深度。

papers.title: Design of Monolithic Microcavities for Enhancing Organic Quantum Emitters
papers.zh: 设计可集成有机单分子发射体的单片微腔，通过 Purcell 增强提升零声子线发射比例，助力单光子源。

papers.title: Cation-Intercalated Mott Insulator α-RuCl3 Superlattice for Actively Tuned Optoelectronics
papers.zh: 片上阳离子插层把 α-RuCl3 变为超晶格，光学带隙由 1.1 eV 缩至 0.6 eV，实现可调 SWIR 光电探测。

papers.title: Air-Stable Nickel Oxide Nanosheets as a Model Platform for Decoupling Structure–Activity Relation in Oxygen Evolving Electrocatalysts
papers.zh: 在 Au(111) 上构建空气稳定的亚单层 NiO 纳米片模型电催化剂，原子尺度解析析氧反应构效关系。

papers.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Control of Dimensionality in the DMAPbBr3 Lead Halide Perovskite for Tunable Optical Emission
Photodoping-Driven Lattice Expansion Enables Polarization Enhancement in Sliding Ferroelectric MoS2
papers.zh: 第一性原理揭示光掺杂使滑移铁电双层 MoS2 面内晶格膨胀约 2%，从而增强铁电极化。

papers.title: Sub-shot-noise terahertz measurement with electric field amplitude modulation via Rydberg atoms
papers.zh: 以压缩光为探针结合里德堡原子与幅度调制，实现 0.14 THz 场强低于散粒噪声极限的量子增强测量。

papers.title: UV Mie-void reflective metasurfaces in silicon
papers.zh: 在硅中构建椭圆 Mie-void 谐振器，将光局域于空气孔内，实现 325 nm 紫外反射式超表面。

papers.title: Analytical Markov Chain for Spatiotemporal Flux Evolution of the Inner Filter Effect in Fluorescent Media
papers.zh: 提出解析马尔可夫链模型，描述荧光介质中内滤效应导致的光通量时空演化。

papers.title: Quantifying light coupling to guided modes in semiconductor slabs with arbitrary scattering patterns
Ultrafast pulse characterization for microscopy by spatially integrated intensity of auto-convolution measurements using nonlinear excitation signal generation
papers.zh: 利用显微焦点处空间积分的非线性信号与光谱调制，无需额外光路即可表征超快脉冲光谱相位与幅度。

papers.title: Brewing Coffee in Ethanol Instead of Water: A Multi-Technique Pilot Study
papers.zh: 对比乙醇与水冲煮咖啡的萃取差异，UV-Vis 显示乙醇中绿原酸/咖啡因谱带比由约 1.2 升至 1.7。

papers.title: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
papers.zh: 实验观测到圆偏振强光在石墨烯狄拉克点打开光致 Haldane 拓扑能隙，实现时间反演对称破缺。

papers.title: Probing the dimensionality of confinement in soft nanoreactors through plasmonic nanoparticles nucleation
papers.zh: 以金纳米颗粒原位成核为光学探针，揭示卵磷脂反胶束软纳米反应器的受限维度决定成核起始。

papers.title: Acoustic Levitation Engineered Au‐InSe Schottky Junctions for Single‐Molecule SERS Sensing
papers.zh: 声悬浮无容器法构建 InSe-Au 肖特基结 SERS 基底，增强因子 10^10，实现仄摩尔级单分子检测。

papers.title: Ligand-Length Asymmetry Controls Nanoscale Heat Flow in Gold Janus Nanorods
papers.zh: 非平衡分子动力学表明，调控单侧配体链长可调谐金 Janus 纳米棒在水中的纳米尺度热流与温度场。

papers.title: Perspectives of Biomaterial‐Based Sustainable Integrated Micro‐ and Nanophotonics
papers.zh: 综述生物材料微纳光子器件，涵盖损耗低至 0.24 dB/cm 的生物聚合物波导、生物 LED 与光伏等。

papers.title: Material Coupling in Hybrid Neuromorphic Devices: From Fundamentals to System‐Level Applications
papers.zh: 综述有机、氧化物、二维材料与钙钛矿杂化神经形态器件中的材料耦合机制及系统级应用。

papers.title: Tetrathiafulvalene-Based Molecular Qubit Frameworks with Room-Temperature Quantum Coherence
papers.zh: 比较 HHTP 与四硫富瓦烯基分子量子比特框架，实现室温量子相干，面向量子传感。

papers.title: High-speed optical target feature extractor based on multimode fiber optical neural network
papers.zh: 基于多模光纤光学神经网络构建高速光学目标特征提取器。

papers.title: Regulation Mechanism of Well-barrier Thickness on Optical Gain and Loss for High-Power Ultraviolet Semiconductor Lasers
High-background X-ray single particle imaging with 2D crystal holographic enhancement
papers.zh: 利用二维晶体全息增强实现高背景下的 X 射线单颗粒成像。

papers.title: Monolithic bimorph mirror concept for X-ray space telescopes
Revealing Phase-Controlled Surface Structure in PtNi Nanocatalysts via In-situ Gas Cell Transmission Electron Microscopy
papers.zh: 用原位气相池 TEM 揭示 PtNi 纳米催化剂晶相对超干甲烷重整反应中表面结构的调控。

papers.title: Learning the dimension of light’s spatial modes
papers.zh: 用机器学习从强度分布识别光空间模式维度（2–15），单维度平均准确率达 99.82%。

papers.title: Integrated GIS-Based Framework for Assessing Climate Change, Ocean Sustainability, and Coastal Resilience Using Multi Hazard in Indian Coast : Case of Tamil Nadu Coastline.
papers.zh: 构建 GIS-MCDA 框架评估泰米尔纳德邦 1076 km 海岸线的多灾害气候风险与海岸韧性。

papers.title: Sub-pixel nanosecond laser irradiation of a color CMOS image sensor: damage thresholds and the role of the color filter array
papers.zh: 研究亚像素纳秒激光辐照彩色 CMOS 图像传感器的损伤阈值及彩色滤光阵列的作用。

papers.title: Ultraviolet to infrared thermally driven SSPM and spatially asymmetric optical propagation in vdW NbOCl₂ nanosheets
papers.zh: 在范德华 NbOCl₂ 纳米片中实现紫外至红外热驱动空间自相位调制及空间非对称光传播。

papers.title: Freeform Mirror Construction for a Panoramic Annular Lens Using Local Arc and Normal Control
A bipartite quantum-acoustic architecture stabilizes multi-exciton solitons at 323 K
papers.zh: 提出双组分量子-声学稳定架构，在 323 K 将三激子 Davydov 孤子相干半衰期由 6.5 fs 延至 42.6 fs。

papers.title: Generative Inverse Design of Shell Metamaterials through Continuous-Latent Conditional Flow Matching
papers.zh: 用连续潜空间条件流匹配生成式逆向设计力学壳体超材料单胞，匹配目标压缩应力-应变曲线。

papers.title: Size and temperature effect on Young's modulus of silicon nanowires
papers.zh: TEM 内 MEMS 拉伸测量 78 根硅纳米线杨氏模量，发现其随直径减小及温度升高（至 600 K）而降低。

papers.title: Study of jump-like superfast domain kinetics in lithium niobate crystals by in situ in-bulk imaging in slanted-cut plate
papers.zh: 在斜切 36° Y 切铌酸锂中原位体内光学成像，揭示畴合并后跳跃式超快畴动力学的分步机制。

papers.title: CO2 laser fabrication of PMMA-based multilayer 3D microchannel networks for tubular organ-on-chip models
papers.zh: 用商用 CO2 激光烧蚀快速制造 PMMA 多层三维微通道器官芯片，孔深宽比约 50:1。

papers.title: Atomic-scale defect-mediated electronic modulation in monolayer Cu2Pb on Cu(111)
papers.zh: 用低温STM/STS结合第一性原理研究Cu(111)上单层Cu2Pb表面合金的本征缺陷及其电子调制。

papers.title: Critical behavior, variable range hopping, and probable topological Hall effect in VCr2Te4 single crystal
papers.zh: 制备 VCr2Te4 单晶，研究其 74 K 亚铁磁转变临界行为、变程跳跃输运及可能的拓扑霍尔效应。

papers.title: All-optical 2D perovskite photodetector arrays for pixelated long-wave infrared imaging
papers.zh: 利用2D金属卤化物钙钛矿反射率温度系数，实现无读出电路的全光像素化LWIR成像探测阵列。

papers.title: Influence of dielectric environment on the optical properties of the CVD-grown monolayer WSe2
papers.zh: 用变温Raman与PL研究介电环境对CVD单层WSe2激子与trion发射的影响，低温和高介电环境促进trion形成。

papers.title: Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolution via Spatio-Angular Consistent Neural Epipolar Geometry Learning
papers.zh: 提出空间-角度一致的神经极平面几何学习框架，实现任意尺度光场空间与角度联合超分辨。

papers.title: Characterizing the Spatiotemporal Boundaries of Functional Ultrasound for Brain Decoding
papers.zh: 以清醒小鼠胡须刺激表征功能超声成像（fUS-CBV）用于脑解码的时空边界。

papers.title: High-Contrast Broadband Optical Edge Detection by Low-Loss Geometric Phase Gratings
papers.zh: 超快激光在石英玻璃中写入纳米孔几何相位光栅，实现宽带高对比光学边缘检测，515 nm对比度达0.97。

papers.title: Destruction of Anderson localization by Kerr nonlinearity in non-Hermitian disordered lattices
papers.zh: 研究非厄米无序晶格中 Kerr 非线性如何破坏 Anderson 局域化。

papers.title: PIN‐PMN‐PT Surface Planar Waveguides Realized via He + Implantation
papers.zh: 采用He+离子注入在PIN-PMN-PT弛豫铁电单晶表层制备平面光波导，面向高性能电光调制器。

papers.title: Membrane‐Targeted Nanoparticles for Neuronal Photomodulation
papers.zh: 以生物正交化学将金双锥等离激元纳米粒子靶向神经元膜，NIR光热实现神经活动抑制。

papers.title: MRSA‐Triggered Disassembly of an Immune‐Recruiting NIR Probe for Bacterial Imaging and Clearance
papers.zh: 设计MRSA触发解组装的免疫招募NIR半花菁探针，实现细菌激活成像与清除。

papers.title: Self‐Powered Ultrafast Solar‐Blind UV Photodetectors Enabled by CdO/SnO 2 Quantum‐Dot Heterojunction Networks
papers.zh: 构建亚5 nm CdO/SnO2量子点异质结网络，实现自供电、纳秒级响应的日盲紫外光电探测。

papers.title: Asymptotic r 2 Enhancement in Formulation‐Optimized Lipid‐Iron Oxide Nanoparticles for Assessing Glioblastoma Heterogeneity at Ultrahigh‐Field MRI
papers.zh: 通过配方调控脂质包覆SPION的r2弛豫率（9.4 T下13–418 mM⁻¹s⁻¹），用于胶质瘤超高场MRI评估。

papers.title: Unveiling Graphitic Carbon Nitride in Hexagonal Boron Nitride Epitaxy on Sapphire
papers.zh: 揭示MOVPE中意外生成的g-C3N4在蓝宝石上传递晶格取向，主导hBN外延对准。

papers.title: Self‐Assembled hBN Wrinkles as Planar Optofluidic Channels
papers.zh: 利用热致褶皱使剥离hBN自组装成无光刻的平面一维纳流控通道网络，可光学观测受限输运。

papers.title: Bioinspired Honeycomb‐Armored Photothermal Superhydrophobic Surface With Robust Mechanical Durability for Efficient Anti‐/De‐Icing
papers.zh: 激光刻蚀蜂窝微阵列并喷涂SiO2/碳纳米管，制备机械耐久的无氟光热超疏水防除冰表面。

papers.title: One‐Step Synthesis of Supramolecular Nanoparticles With Interlocking‐Enhanced Two‐Photon Fluorescence
papers.zh: 一步超分子组装制备PMBT纳米粒子，借互锁结构增强双光子荧光且无需扩展π共轭。

papers.title: Beyond Micro‐/Nanostructures: Close‐Packed Nanostructure Enables Superior Superhydrophobic Anti‐Icing Coatings
papers.zh: 对比同化学组成涂层，发现密堆纳米结构的超疏水防冰性能优于分级微纳结构。

papers.title: Photon-pairing-enhanced distributed spectroscopy sensing over 400 km optical fiber
papers.zh: 利用光子配对增强技术，实现400 km光纤上的分布式光谱传感。
